about: Golden cases for the generic matcher, version 1 (spec 3.5). Every title is synthetic: written for this repo, every detail invented (ADR 0023). The example products exist only here and never reach production. Hardware cases are the 209 classifier titles of fixtures/titles.v1.ts with example products; where the word rules let a listing through that the old code rejected, the case says so in its note and the expectation records what the matcher does, because Claude now confirms the product. Change an expectation only together with the rule it covers.
